pulls.author: zifeihan
pulls.body_excerpt: Hi, please consider. pulls.title: 8373730: Missing identity optimization in arithmetic Or
pulls.author: benshuai5D
pulls.body_excerpt: **Problem:** C2 performs identity simplification for some `Or` nodes, but it does not simplify expressions with duplicate operands such as: - `a | (b | a)` - `a | (a | b)` - `(a | b) | a` - `(b | a) | a` **Fix:** Add checks to `OrINode::Identity()` and `OrLNode::Identity()` to return the existing inner OR node when either of its operands matches the other operand of the outer OR. Also add the outer OR to the IGVN worklist when an input of the inner OR changes. **Testing:** - Added tests for `a | (b | a)` and `(a | b) | a` in `OrINodeIdealizationTests.java` and `OrLNodeIdealizationTests.java`.

pulls.author: iklam
pulls.body_excerpt: Normally, all classes that should be stored in the AOT cache are discovered by `AOTArtifactFinder` using `MetaspaceClosure` to recursively scan for all reachable classes. pulls.title: 8391914: x86: Optimize StringUTF16.compress intrinsic with AVX2

pulls.author: pf0n
pulls.body_excerpt: There's a performance improvement for p100 if GenShen goes into a degenerated cycle instead of a full GC for humongous allocation failure. The collector can still go into a full GC if it reaches a certain amount of consecutive degenerated cycles. We're only removing the path where it goes into a full GC right after humongous allocation failure. The measurement here is the "average p100 for individual latency" in microseconds. Before this change, average p100 was 2.2 seconds and now it's down to 124ms.
